implementation.scope: Actual 828138F8 direct-vtable lower and two caller-frame funclets. Preserves lower 64-bit r31 save/restore, 32-bit SP/r3 spills, full-width GPR arithmetic and the 8208018C field write.

validation.tested_scope: Actual 828138F8 lower, direct and spill-alias cases plus both callers with high and wrapped caller-frame values. Correct 8208018C vtable store, selected full GPR/SP/LR, spills and ordinary RAM.
validation.unvalidated_scope: Faults, MMIO, concurrency, unselected ABI and runtime.
